landing.mission.title: Our Mission & Vision
landing.mission.subtitle: Building the future of inclusive education through strategic phases
landing.mission.year1.title: Year 1 (2025–2026) – Validation & Foundation
landing.mission.year1.mission: Prove that AI-powered sign language avatars and accessibility tools work in real classrooms.
landing.mission.year1.point2: Partner with one NGO to test inclusivity at community events.
landing.mission.year1.point3: Build the core LGK (Lithuanian Sign Language) dataset with teachers and Deaf community contributors.
landing.mission.year2.title: Year 2 (2026–2027) – Expansion & Early Revenue
landing.mission.year2.mission: Show that LearnInclusive can scale beyond Lithuania and begin generating revenue.
landing.mission.year2.point1: Enter Polish schools with Polish Sign Language support.
landing.mission.year2.point4: Partner with media/education content providers for LGK accessibility.
landing.mission.year3.title: Year 3 (2027–2028) – Innovation & Baltic Scale
landing.mission.year3.mission: Become the leading accessibility-first EdTech platform in the Baltic region.
landing.mission.year3.point2: Pilot sign-to-sign translation technology (LGK ↔ Latvian SL ↔ Estonian SL).
landing.mission.year3.point3: Sign 10–15 long-term contracts with schools across Lithuania and Poland.
landing.mission.year4.title: Year 4 (2028–2029) – System-Wide Adoption
landing.mission.year4.mission: Achieve full adoption in Lithuania and Poland and secure recognition as a European leader.
landing.mission.year4.point2: Become the default compliance solution for municipalities under the EU Accessibility Act 2025.
landing.mission.year4.point3: Expand accessibility features to low-vision and multilingual learners.
landing.mission.framework: Our strategic framework builds from validation through scalability to market leadership, positioning learninclusive as the definitive accessibility-first solution in European education.
landing.about.title: About Learninclusive
landing.about.description1: Born from the belief that education should be accessible to everyone, Learninclusive is the first learning management system built with accessibility as its foundation, not as an afterthought.
landing.about.description2: We comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards and Lithuanian accessibility legislation, ensuring that students with visual, auditory, motor, and cognitive disabilities can fully participate in their education.
landing.mission.missionContent: To break down barriers in education by creating the world's most accessible learning platform. We believe every student, regardless of their abilities or disabilities, deserves equal access to quality education. Our mission is to empower educators with tools that make learning truly inclusive, ensuring no student is left behind in their educational journey.
landing.mission.visionContent: A world where accessibility in education is not an afterthought, but the foundation upon which all learning experiences are built. We envision a future where every educational institution has the tools and knowledge to create truly inclusive environments, where diversity in learning needs is celebrated and supported through cutting-edge, accessible technology.
